blockers.detail: The header/rest operation is idempotent. A repeated nonempty rest forces the second maximal common prefix above k unless k is4; a literal multi-atom group would instead require a header on its second occurrence. Full-group/line binding and distinct atomic initials are assumptions, not established native atoms.

Only the declared literal/fixed working-glyph binding is assessed. Transcription and a source-aware local image comparison do not establish a universal native atomic inventory, word meanings or historical use.
